Details 
 The Tri Color Hat blends bold design with classic comfort. Featuring a durable twill front and breathable mesh back, this high-profile snapback delivers a sharp flat bill silhouette. The sublimated patch and logo embroidery add vibrant detail, making this hat a standout for any casual or ranch-ready look.
- Fabric: Twill Front Mesh Back
- Fit: Snapback | High-Profile | Flat Bill
- Details: Sublimated Patch, Logo Embroidery
